posture.headline: Power and nuclear remain the live macro; energy risk premium rises, while stale cyclicals lose support
posture.summary: Fresh evidence continues to validate the electricity-scarcity and nuclear buildout theses, with India emerging as a meaningful incremental demand and capex center. Energy supply-constraint also benefits from renewed Hormuz/Middle East risk premium, though infrastructure redundancy tempers the most extreme scarcity outcomes. By contrast, several lower-conviction baskets lack fresh confirming evidence and should be marked down on staleness alone, with copper specifically under pressure.

theses.title: AI power infrastructure bottleneck
theses.coreClaim: AI data-center growth is creating durable demand for grid, electrical, power-services, and behind-the-meter infrastructure providers.
theses.whyItMightCompound: Capacity bottlenecks can persist for years, pushing spend toward scarce engineering, construction, power-equipment, and specialized energy assets.
whatMustBeTrue: AI compute demand remains power-constrained rather than model-demand constrained.
Utilities, hyperscalers, and industrial customers continue funding grid and power upgrades.
Selected companies can convert demand into margin and backlog without severe execution or valuation risk.
invalidators: AI infrastructure demand slows materially or power intensity falls faster than expected.
Valuations price in most of the bottleneck upside.
Permitting, grid interconnect, or supply-chain limits prevent revenue conversion.
theses.convictionWhy: Multiple existing notes point to AI power bottlenecks, but asset-specific valuation and competitive positioning still need work.

theses.title: Critical materials and defense infrastructure
theses.coreClaim: Supply-chain resilience, rearmament, nuclear fuel, drones, aerospace components, and critical materials may support durable investment themes.
theses.whyItMightCompound: Geopolitical fragmentation and industrial policy can create long-lived demand for constrained domestic/allied capacity.
whatMustBeTrue: Defense and resilience spending remains structurally elevated.
Chosen companies have defensible niches rather than commodity exposure only.
Valuation leaves room for multi-year compounding.
invalidators: Spending normalizes or political support fades.
Theme is too broad to create investable edge.
Best assets are already priced for perfection.
theses.convictionWhy: Theme is interesting but still needs segmentation by supply-chain stage and asset quality.

watchRules.triggerDescription: Keep tracked AI power infrastructure candidates on watchlist when stretched; alert when a candidate enters a pre-defined value range or has a meaningful pullback while thesis conditions still hold.
watchRules.messageTemplate: {symbol} is back near the value range for the {thesisTitle} thesis. If the thesis still holds and portfolio room exists, remember to accumulate on pullbacks. Pause if: {pauseCondition}.
watchRules.stretchedMessageTemplate: {symbol} still fits the {thesisTitle} thesis, but valuation/action conditions are not attractive enough. Keep it on watchlist; do not chase. Revisit on pullbacks into the value range.
